subject: Dedicated isolated GPU pool & KMS -- pricing options
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@fintecture.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Marcus Chen <mchen@fintecture.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-06-18T08:13:00+01:00
Subject: Dedicated isolated deployment — sizing & pricing request

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the deterministic latency and the routing/fallback story. We are evaluating Dedicated with single-tenant isolation for a payments fraud model. A few asks so we can build our internal TCO: 

- Can you send committed-capacity pricing scenarios for 3 sizing options (baseline 2x A100-equivalent, steady-state 8x, and peak 16x) with monthly reserved commits?
- We need explicit throughput SLOs (tokens/sec or infer/sec) per sizing bucket and a clear overage policy.
- Important: we require KMS-managed keys (customer-owned) + audit log retention for 13 months. Please itemize any recurring fees for KMS, and the cost to retain audit logs beyond 90 days.
- Any isolation surcharge for single-tenant pools (per GPU-hour or flat addon)?
- Outline ramp/phase discounts (first 3 months ramp, then full commit) and early termination terms.

I've attached our security questionnaire (Fintecture_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) — two questions specifically call out KMS and access to raw logs.

Target timeline: procurement would like a formal commercial so we can budget for FY27. Hoping to get a few options by end of next week.

Best,
Elena

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear brief and for sending the questionnaire. Per your asks, I attached a short commercial with three committed scenarios plus an isolation/KMS add-on breakdown (SO_Pricing_Scenarios_v3.pdf). High-level summary below.

--- Commercial scenarios (monthly reserved commit pricing, list USD shown as examples) ---
1) Starter (2 x A100-equivalent)
   - Reserved commit: 2 GPUs, 24 months commitment 
   - Throughput SLO: 1.2k tokens/sec sustained (single model, 2 concurrent streams)
   - Price: $28,000/month base commit
   - Isolation surcharge: $0.80/GPU-hour (applies only when pool is dedicated/isolation mode)
   - KMS: customer KMS integration fee $650/month (covers HSM route + rotation audit)
   - Audit logs: 90 days included; $120/month per additional 30-day block (charged per retention bucket)

2) Growth (8 x A100-equivalent)
   - Reserved commit: 8 GPUs, 24 months
   - Throughput SLO: 5k tokens/sec sustained (up to 8 concurrent streams)
   - Price: $95,000/month base commit
   - Isolation surcharge: $0.65/GPU-hour (volume-discounted)
   - KMS: $650/month (same as above)
   - Audit logs: 90 days included; $420/month per additional 30-day block

3) Enterprise (16 x A100-equivalent)
   - Reserved commit: 16 GPUs, 36 months (preferred for enterprise pricing)
   - Throughput SLO: 11k tokens/sec sustained (multi-model routing, up to 20 concurrent streams)
   - Price: $175,000/month base commit
   - Isolation surcharge: $0.50/GPU-hour
   - KMS: $650/month
   - Audit logs: 90 days included; $800/month per additional 30-day block

Other commercial notes:
- Overage: we bill per-GPU-hour at 1.8x the committed unit rate for the month. We can instead do a drawdown model where headroom is consumed and reconciled monthly.
- Ramp months: first 3 months can be billed at 50% of monthly commit to accommodate initial onboarding; discounts tied to 24/36 month committments below.
- Early termination: pro-rated remaining commit with a 30% reduction for unused months if customer provides 60 days notice and a 6-month minimum usage was achieved.

Next steps: please confirm which sizing scenario you want priced with a discount tier and whether Fintecture will do COOP (bring-your-own-KMS) or require Redwood-managed HSM. We can also scope a short perf validation run on Growth sizing to validate throughput numbers.

I'll loop in Neha to confirm the perf test plan and KMS technical details.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Dedicated isolated deployment — sizing & pricing request

Hi Elena — quick technical follow-up from the infra side that will affect commit sizing/pricing.

- The throughput SLOs above assume A100-class instances with the following optimizations: continuous batching (up to 32 requests), KV cache pinned in memory, and quantized model variants. If you expect large prompt prefixes (>1k tokens) we should account for increased memory and lower tokens/sec.
- For the perf validation run we recommend Growth (8 GPUs) with a 48-hour soak test using your 3 most common prompt patterns. We will instrument token-level latency traces and provide a cost/throughput report.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS, GCP CMEK, or an HSM. The $650/month line is the integration + key-rotation audit cost — if you need an HSM-backed dedicated KMS instance there is an additional one-time setup of $9k and $350/month for HSM reservations.
- Audit logs: 13 months retention requested — we can provide 13 months but the incremental cost for Fintecture's expected log volume (est. 40GB/month) would be approximately $1,100/month for storage + index charges. We can convert that to a fixed line item if you prefer predictability.

If procurement prefers a single line for "compliance addon" we can bundle the isolation surcharge + KMS + audit retention into a single monthly fee for simplicity; rough ballpark for Growth would be $8,500/month. If you want I can produce a bundled vs itemized comparison.

Rafael — FYI: the bundled compliance line gives a cleaner procurement ask but reduces pricing granularity for our finance team.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Subject: Internal: approve discount for Fintecture — Growth scenario

Marissa / Karthik,

Fintecture are leaning toward the Growth (8 GPUs) sizing and asked me to put a discounted commercial to procurement. Requested discount: 18% off the listed base commit in exchange for a 24-month firm commit and their acceptance of the bundled compliance addon.

Quick P&L notes (approx):
- Growth base list: $95k/month -> with 18% discount = $77,900/month
- Compliance bundle (itemized would be ~$8.5k/month) -> included as a pass-through in the proposal currently
- Net EAR: roughly $69k/month after expected resale costs and infra ops (very rough estimate)

Asks: please confirm approval to offer 18% (or authorize a counter at 15%). We will require sign-off for the 3-month 50% ramp and the early-termination 30% unused reduction clause.

I recommend we hold 18% if we can secure a 24-month firm commit and a positive reference clause. Otherwise we offer 15% and require the 36-month term for the same net economics.

Thanks,
Rafael

Hi Elena / Marcus — thanks for your patience — internal approvals came through and I have the revised proposal below (also attached as a final SOW).

Offer (Growth — 8 GPUs):
- Committed: 8 GPUs, 24 months
- Discount: 15% applied to base commit (list $95,000 -> $80,750/month)
- Compliance addon: itemized in SOW (KMS integration $650/month, audit retention to 13 months $1,100/month estimate, isolation surcharge $0.65/GPU-hour) — or consolidated as a single compliance line of $7,750/month if you prefer procurement simplicity.
- Ramp: first 3 months billed at 50% of the discounted commit to accommodate onboarding and perf validation.
- Throughput SLO: 5k tokens/sec sustained (documented in SOW) with a perf validation run to be scheduled during onboarding.
- Early termination: pro-rated with 30% reduction for unused months (60 days notice).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm whether you want the compliance addon itemized or consolidated.
2) If OK, Rafael to send an initial commercial (PO + SOW) for Fintecture procurement to review.
3) Neha will schedule the 48-hour perf validation during the ramp window.

We can also carve an optional "reference" clause that would move the discount to 18% after six months of go-live if you provide a public quote. Happy to add that if helpful.

Regards,
